_: A copy of this with your own test installs' paths is run.py's CONFIG. Keys that start with _ are notes.
_profile: Copied for every run, so each starts from the same progress. Its INPUT setting is DIRECT CONNECT.
_guitar_input: Optional: the same input device, channel and gain for both editions (RS_AUDIO_INPUT_FILE).
_helpers: Processes beside the game whose CPU is counted too, by name.
_env: Switches for both editions, on top of run.py's ENV_PINS.
_mods_settings: Optional: copied to each edition's "mods_settings" before a run, so the mods have the same switches.
_ini: Rocksmith.ini keys for both editions, on top of run.py's INI_PINS.
